show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/m2YDCD
show.description: Karan, a poor scrap-collector boy, struggles to save his cancer-stricken mother, unaware he’s the lost heir of the powerful Rathore family. Twenty years later, Rama Rathore has built an empire but still searches for her vanished son. Fate brings them face-to-face, mother and son, unaware of their blood bond, just as betrayal, greed, and revenge close in. The moment truth surfaces, everything they’ve built may burn, because the royal prince is about to return. Watch Now!
